claims.polish-quality: Post-ASR polish/cleanup quality: content preserved, no hallucination, filler/formatting/casing rules, honest adversarial scoring.
claims.ipc-contract: IPC surface names/casing and settings-caller contracts (name says what it guards)
claims.clipboard-safety: Clipboard content is never destroyed, truncated, or clobbered by dictation (restore-before-clear, image/file handling).
claims.text-integrity: The user's text survives the pipeline byte-for-byte: encoding, ITN, and edit-offset correctness with no silent mangling.
claims.delivery-safety: Injection into the active app is safe: correct target field, ordering, hotkey/permission gating, and no stray input.
claims.asr-quality: Transcription quality and robustness: non-Latin round-trips, no false triggers on noise, accuracy gates against gold fixtures.
claims.command-mode: Voice command classification and extraction: the right command fires, with the right arguments, and nothing fires when it should not.
claims.learning: The personalization learning loop: correction judgement accuracy, promote/demote behaviour, and learning-data lifecycle.
claims.i18n: Internationalization: non-Latin scripts, locale formats, and locale-specific behaviour stay correct end to end.
claims.concurrency: Thread and task safety of the core pipeline under load: no deadlocks, lost state, or data races across 1,000+ back-to-back runs.
claims.perf-budget: Latency and memory budgets for model load and inference stay within the published envelope.
claims.ui-behavior: The React UI renders and behaves correctly: screens, pill states, settings controls, hotkey capture, and accessibility.
claims.build-migration: Existing user data and build artifacts survive upgrades: old-version fixtures still parse and the app migrates forward.
claims.e2e-journey: End-user journeys a person actually takes, from first launch onward, hold their invariants as a whole.
claims.audio-pipeline: Audio decode, resample, and device seams produce correct PCM for downstream engines.
claims.model-integrity: Model outputs are structurally valid and byte-compatible with their reference implementation or schema (no silent drift).
claims.eval-integrity: Eval harness and ratchet gates refuse to pass, compare, or seed a baseline from runs that did not actually measure what they claim (missing replay rows, zero scored clips, zero active checks).
claims.unclassified: Baseline-only: claim not derivable from the file's docs; burn down over time
